description: Fail-closed, capability-specific evidence links that cannot be inferred safely from structured Airboard corpora. Semantic nodes/actions and reference kinds are read from production at validation time; this file does not duplicate those registries.

inputChannels.reason: The shared production channel contract composes local, media, catalog, and remote-event inputs while explicitly excluding legacy physical-marker and air-writing paths.

gestures.reason: Production exports frame owners, not stable release-evaluation names. Each release name is therefore mapped to an imported GESTURE_FRAME_PRIORITY owner.

surfaces.reason: The production Surface union is type-only. Values here cover every routable board surface; Meet values remain private-preview surfaces rather than a public availability claim.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/capabilityCoverageEvidence.test.mjs#grounds every shipped node type and applies its final graph
staticEvidence.rationale: The test iterates the imported production node registry, resolves one semantic create action per exact node type, commits it through DiagramCommand/BoardEvent, and asserts canonical terminal type and geometry.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/semanticPlan.test.mjs#parses creates, same-plan handles, and labelled branches
staticEvidence.rationale: The strict production plan parser validates the declared create/branch/reference shapes. Grounding and terminal graph evidence are supplied separately by production-grounder tests.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/semanticPlan.test.mjs#accepts every supported typed action variant
staticEvidence.rationale: The test supplies each typed production action/reference shape to the strict plan contract and asserts acceptance; it makes no grounding claim.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/semanticPlan.test.mjs#rejects invalid variants for every reference kind
staticEvidence.rationale: The test enumerates every production reference kind and proves a capability-specific invalid variant is rejected before grounding.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/intentPipeline.test.mjs#grounds a create operation into a diagram command at the pointer
staticEvidence.rationale: The real grounder binds a pointer reference to the captured canvas point and asserts the resulting command and selection.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/intentPipeline.test.mjs#grounding a selection edit without a selection fails closed
staticEvidence.rationale: An unresolved current selection terminates without a mutation.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/intentPipeline.test.mjs#REGRESSION: reverses the existing edge, adds only the missing edge, and undoes both together
staticEvidence.rationale: The production grounder resolves visible endpoint labels and a connection reference, applies the final graph state, and proves its undo.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/intentPipeline.test.mjs#grounds delete_connection against endpoint bindings
staticEvidence.rationale: The production grounder resolves a connector in either endpoint order, emits the exact deletion target, and fails closed for a missing endpoint.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/capabilityCoverageEvidence.test.mjs#grounds ordinal decision branches and applies their final graph
staticEvidence.rationale: The real semantic grounder resolves spatial ordinals, emits two labelled branch commands, and the production reducer reaches the asserted graph.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/diagramCommands.test.mjs#creates annotation-compatible nodes and snapped connectors through BoardEvents
staticEvidence.rationale: Commands are reduced through real BoardEvents and the committed node/connector state is asserted.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/diagramCommands.test.mjs#rename, resize, and cascade delete remain undoable with existing event types
staticEvidence.rationale: Committed rename/delete state and cascade behavior are asserted through the production reducer.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/diagramCommands.test.mjs#groups stay renderer-compatible and duplicate with remapped memberships
staticEvidence.rationale: The final group membership and duplicated identity graph are asserted.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/diagramCommands.test.mjs#moving a node keeps attached connectors bound and compensating events undo both
staticEvidence.rationale: Final moved-node and attached-connector geometry plus undo are asserted.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:packages/core/test/diagramCommands.test.mjs#align and layout produce deterministic constraint-based geometry
staticEvidence.rationale: The deterministic constraint commands assert terminal multi-object geometry.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/capabilityCoverageEvidence.test.mjs#grounds distribution and applies deterministic final geometry
staticEvidence.rationale: The semantic grounder emits the production distribute-x command and the reducer asserts evenly spaced final geometry.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/capabilityCoverageEvidence.test.mjs#cancel remains an immediate no-mutation terminal result
staticEvidence.rationale: The production parser and resolver classify cancel as immediate handling and leave the board snapshot unchanged.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/capabilityCoverageEvidence.test.mjs#grounds selection and applies its final non-board state
staticEvidence.rationale: The production semantic grounder resolves a visible label and asserts the exact terminal selection without a board mutation.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/capabilityCoverageEvidence.test.mjs#plan handles ground to committed objects and apply their final state
staticEvidence.rationale: The production semantic grounder resolves the plan handle and the reducer applies the resulting rename to the committed object.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/voiceRouting.spec.ts#one open-palm swipe left undoes exactly one automatic voice action
staticEvidence.rationale: Mounted browser state proves one gesture removes exactly one committed object.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/typedCommand.spec.ts#typing a command creates and edits objects instantly
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted typed composer runs parse, ground, commit, render, selection, delete, and undo.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/diagramVisibility.spec.ts#snap, keyboard, menu, and voice share one local visibility action
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted typed path grounds visibility commands and explicitly rejects a hidden-state edit without changing BoardState.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/gestureObjectManipulation.test.mjs#closing a hand over an object can still move that object
staticEvidence.rationale: Production landmark manipulation resolves the intended object and emits one grab start.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/gestureObjectManipulation.test.mjs#closing a hand on empty canvas cannot begin a lasso or mutate the board
staticEvidence.rationale: Empty-canvas input is rejected without a target, action, lasso, or board mutation.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/landmarkNavigationInput.test.mjs#two raw open-hand landmark streams engage Pan and preserve shared motion
staticEvidence.rationale: Raw two-hand landmarks are grounded into a terminal navigation state and motion.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/landmarkNavigationInput.test.mjs#one or incomplete landmark hands cannot reserve two-hand navigation
staticEvidence.rationale: Incomplete and single-hand inputs fail closed.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/interactionTrackers.test.mjs#a single presented palm swiped left emits one undo
staticEvidence.rationale: The production tracker grounds one qualifying palm trajectory to one undo edge.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/interactionTrackers.test.mjs#undo swipe rejects vertical motion, suppression, and repeat firing
staticEvidence.rationale: Conflicting motion, arbitration suppression, and repeats are rejected.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/snapGestureTracker.test.mjs#real-camera transition frames and a naturally curled snap pose remain armed
staticEvidence.rationale: Production snap state remains grounded through realistic landmark transition frames.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/snapGestureTracker.test.mjs#slow release and jitter do not snap
staticEvidence.rationale: Slow and jittered near-gesture motion does not trigger.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/palmVoiceGestureTracker.test.mjs#a stable open palm activates one voice turn after 400 ms
staticEvidence.rationale: The production hold tracker grounds the shipped pose and duration to one activation.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/palmVoiceGestureTracker.test.mjs#suppression and an ambiguous hand count cannot arm the palm voice hold
staticEvidence.rationale: Arbitration suppression and ambiguous ownership fail closed.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/voiceRouting.spec.ts#an open palm must hold for 400 ms, activates voice once, and releases cleanly
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted voice-gate UI reaches and cleanly leaves its terminal state.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/interactionTrackers.test.mjs#hold-to-edit scopes after holding an element still
staticEvidence.rationale: A held production target becomes the scoped terminal edit state.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/interactionTrackers.test.mjs#hold-to-edit never scopes a moving drag
staticEvidence.rationale: A moving near-match is rejected.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/catalogDock.spec.ts#air hover opens a category and one close-drag-release carries a shape
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted catalog validates direct target geometry and final placement for the shared pointer/air-cursor path.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/directInputChannels.spec.ts#pointer, touchpad, and stylus streams ground to attributed final state
staticEvidence.rationale: Mounted production handlers move a node by primary mouse input, reject a non-primary drag, classify touchpad and pen streams, commit through BoardEvents, and assert terminal geometry/source attribution.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/directInputChannels.spec.ts#pointer, touchpad, and stylus streams ground to attributed final state
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted pointer path explicitly rejects a non-primary mouse drag and asserts unchanged terminal node geometry.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/canvasViewport.spec.ts#ctrl+wheel zooms; plain wheel pans; limits hold
staticEvidence.rationale: Mounted wheel/pinch navigation changes only the viewport under extreme input and explicitly asserts that BoardState remains empty.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/inputCapabilities.test.mjs#non-pen pointer events cannot be misattributed to stylus
staticEvidence.rationale: The production pointer classifier reserves stylus attribution for pen events and rejects mouse, touch, empty, and unknown pointer types.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/interactionTrackers.test.mjs#a category close edge never activates or consumes the tool latch
staticEvidence.rationale: A partial catalog activation cannot select a tool or consume the one-shot latch.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: test:apps/web/test/boardSync.test.mjs#publish reports drops while disconnected and does not poison echo dedup
staticEvidence.rationale: A lost collaboration transport reports the dropped event and preserves exact-once deduplication state.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/boardSync.spec.ts#two browsers share one live board; reload rehydrates it
staticEvidence.rationale: Two mounted clients observe remote BoardEvents, reduce the shared graph, and verify the same final graph after rehydration.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/diagramVisibility.spec.ts#snap, keyboard, menu, and voice share one local visibility action
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted keyboard shortcut invokes the shared visibility action and the test observes the resulting hidden state.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/directInputChannels.spec.ts#pointer, touchpad, and stylus streams ground to attributed final state
staticEvidence.rationale: With the production canvas focused, an unbound keyboard input is ignored and terminal node geometry remains unchanged.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/diagramVisibility.spec.ts#snap, keyboard, menu, and voice share one local visibility action
staticEvidence.rationale: A snap emitted through the production gesture hook reaches the shared visibility action and the mounted final hidden state.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/mediaOwnership.spec.ts#standalone combines camera and voice into one Airo entry point
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted standalone route reaches its final media-entry UI.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/mediaOwnership.spec.ts#standalone never opens a surprise prompt when remembered permission is not granted
staticEvidence.rationale: The standalone surface fails closed without a browser grant.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/mediaOwnership.spec.ts#delegated main stage restores gesture and voice entry points without auto-starting capture
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted delegated main-stage route exposes the intended controls without violating media-start policy.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/mediaOwnership.spec.ts#undelegated main stage offers the companion window instead of media buttons
staticEvidence.rationale: The undelegated main-stage route removes invalid embedded media controls.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/meetMediaBridge.spec.ts#hidden diagram restores raw Meet camera and resumes the compositor without recapturing
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted bridge reaches and recovers the final main-stage compositor state.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/mediaOwnership.spec.ts#delegated side panel stays compact and points at the shared board
staticEvidence.rationale: The mounted delegated side panel resolves to its compact shared-board UI.

staticEvidence.evidenceId: browser:apps/web/e2e/mediaOwnership.spec.ts#undelegated side panel stays compact and routes media to the companion window
staticEvidence.rationale: The undelegated side panel fails over instead of exposing invalid capture.

physicalMedia.note: PR coverage is synthetic, redacted, or emulated. It must never be presented as participant or real-device evidence. Release mode requires the consented participant-held-out assets declared by these manifests.
